We have applied 20810, then 2895 on product1 gave nitro substituted aromatic? Actually 2895 gave "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". Good.

Then 1914397 on that gave two fragments: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". Good.

Then 1914398 on the aromatic brominated nitro gave "BrBr" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". So we removed Br? Actually product is same aromatic core without Br? Good.

Then 1914399 on that gave something? We haven't applied yet. Need to apply 1914399 to "O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". Let's apply.
